project.name: TILDA - Bicycle Parking
project.description: TILDA processes bicycle parking facilities, e-scooter parking, mobility hubs and bike rental stations from OpenStreetMap data to analyze parking capacity, type, and accessibility.

tags.description: Selects bicycle parking features for this topic. Cargo bike parking is a bicycle parking with cargo bike spaces only, or with cargo_bike=designated.
Selects parking for e-scooters and other small electric vehicles for this topic.
Selects kick-scooter parking for this topic, handled like small electric vehicle parking.
Selects mobility hubs for this topic. Stands and rental stations inside a mobility hub are flagged in_mobility_hub; the hub itself is not counted as parking.
Selects bike sharing stations for this topic. Bicycle rental shops (bicycle_rental=shop) and virtual rental stations are not included.
Type of a bike sharing station (docking_station, dropoff_point, key_dispensing_machine).
Network or association a bike sharing station, mobility hub or parking belongs to.
Total capacity; normalized together with `capacity:*` sub-keys when present.
Number of cargo bike spaces. Subtracted from capacity, so capacity counts the normal bicycle spaces.
Who may use the parking (e.g. yes, private, permissive, customers, members, no).
Whether parking is covered (yes, no, partial).
Whether use of the parking is subject to a fee.
Whether the location is lit (yes or no).
Whether cargo bicycles are explicitly accommodated (yes, designated for cargo bikes only).
Physical form of the parking (stands, shed, lockers, two-tier, …).
Number of parking facilities (e.g. stands) at the location.
Where the parking is located, e.g. sidewalk, lane, kerb_extension, shoulder, parklet.
Where the bicycle parking is located; takes precedence over position.
Where the e-scooter or small electric vehicle parking is located; takes precedence over position.
Where the mobility hub is located; takes precedence over position.
Where the bike sharing station is located; takes precedence over position.
Related traffic sign reference, normalized in processing.
Name of the facility.
Name of the operator.
Whether the operator is classified as public or private.
Surface of the parking area.
Whether the parking is indoors (yes).
Surveillance of the parking, e.g. outdoor, public, camera or private.
Maximum duration a bicycle or vehicle may stay parked.
Free text description of the facility.
Mapillary photo ID of the facility.
